plugins.description: Full-lifecycle IT consulting expert for Japanese SIer engagements: 18 skills, 14 agents and the sier calculation engine. One engagement workspace and one cited RFP extraction (NotebookLM) feed every skill; effort, cost, price, Go/No-Go, EVM, SLA and change figures are computed by tested code, never by the model; a presale agent team runs the bid with human gates and an independent review board checks it before submission.
